# Edge case 1: Path with spaces inside double quotes
"/path with spaces/to/my file.txt:12:4"

# Edge case 2: Path with spaces inside single quotes
'src/deeply nested/config file.toml'

# Edge case 3: Unicode Cyrillic paths and line numbers
"/home/user/проекты/тест_скрипт.py:100:5"

# Edge case 4: Unicode emoji and CJK characters
"docs/🚀_release/日本語ドキュメント.md"

# Edge case 5: Punctuation and brackets wrapping URL and file:line
(see https://mox.rs/docs?query=test&id=1, or file: src/lib.rs:10).

# Edge case 6: Overlapping URL, git clone, and git commit hash
git@github.com:hackerman111/Mox.git commit 9f8e7d6c5b4a32101234567890abcdef12345678

# Edge case 7: Trailing commas, semicolons, and colons
Check endpoints: 10.0.0.1; 192.168.1.1:8080, and https://127.0.0.1/api.
